name: Bokukko de Kemomimi Zokusei na Otoko no Ko ga Shokushu ni Okasare Kairaku Ochi
original_name: ボクっ娘でケモミミ属性な男の娘が触手に犯され快楽堕ち
source:
This is a story about a protagonist who sets out to hunt monsters
but is overpowered and relentlessly attacked by tentacles.
translation:
This is a story about a protagonist who sets out to hunt monsters
but is overpowered and relentlessly attacked by tentacles.
